Rx Vet Notes by TVG — Android v0.1.2

Requires Android 8.0+ and internet. Download the APK, open it on your phone
and choose Install. If prompted, allow installation from your browser or
file manager. This updates earlier app versions without uninstalling them.

This release keeps the same application ID and signing certificate.
Version code: 3. Only INTERNET permission is requested.
The icon supports adaptive Android launchers and Android 13+ themed icons.
Website updates appear automatically; More > Refresh page loads current content.

SHA256SUMS.txt verifies the APK file. Signing keys are never included here.

Loading: the header-style logo gently pulses while opening a page. Startup
uses a centered wordmark; later pages use a compact status chip. It clears as
soon as content is visible. Disable Android animations for a static indicator.
